correctness.rationale: Complete 32768-mask check against two independent predicates; 76 replayed elementary collapses leave a genuine 3-dimensional complex. A 91-triangle nonabelian Tietze-elimination certificate kills all pi1 generators. The signed third-boundary matrix has 159 integral unit pivots and exactly zero residual; thus H2 and H3 are each free of rank 15. Simply connected 3-dimensional CW complexes with these torsion-free groups split as wedges of 2- and 3-spheres. The bundled independent mod-2 boundary reductions agree, but mod-2 alone is not used to prove homotopy.

value.rationale: The family L(K_n) is established in general-position extremal theory. At n=6 the full 15-vertex complex is nonpure, and its unexpected simply connected mixed-dimensional homotopy type (15 two-spheres and 15 three-spheres) is a natural complete integral invariant beyond all prior cardinality and facet-count results. The finite exact classification can benchmark topological methods for induced cluster complexes; no larger-family extension is asserted.
